claims.description: Submission now gates on isFinalTranscript in addition to the stop-listening transition; late final replaces interim for grading; per-cycle guard bounds empty/cancelled/error paths to at most one submission.

Three red-first regression tests distinguish stop-listening from final-transcript readiness: late-final replacement with exactly one submission, cancelled with zero submissions, terminal error with zero submissions.
Related suites re-runnable via the standard focused jest invocation.
